title: Smooth collapse with unbounded normalized Chern curvature
established: An explicit Gauduchon Chern--Ricci flow on a non-K\"ahler elliptic bundle converges smoothly after normalization while its normalized full Chern curvature grows at least as $c\sqrt t$.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: Counterexample to bounded normalized full Chern curvature, despite smooth normalized convergence.
